description: The sonic palette and mix philosophy.
prompt_template:
Given this style guide:
{style_guide}

Generate {count} audio style options covering:
- Music palette: chiptune (square+triangle) | tracker (mod/xm) | ambient_drone | jazz | textural | found_sound | silence_with_sfx_only
- SFX palette: synth_only (no samples) | sample_only | mixed
- Mix philosophy: music_driven | sfx_driven | atmospheric (low everything) | dynamic (ducks during dialog)
- Reactive sound: minimal | moderate | heavy
- Effects chain: dry | light_reverb (delay line) | heavy_processing (bitcrusher+filter+overdrive)
- default_synth_shapes: array of playdate.sound waveform constants used by default (kWaveSquare, kWaveSine, kWaveTriangle, kWaveSawtooth, kWaveNoise, kWavePOPhase, kWavePOVOSIM, kWavePOSample)

Return a JSON array of exactly {count} options matching option_schema.
refinement_prompt: Revise the audio option below per the user feedback. Keep default_synth_shapes consistent with music_palette.

option_schema.name: string
option_schema.music_palette: enum: chiptune | tracker | ambient_drone | jazz | textural | found_sound | silence_with_sfx_only
option_schema.preview_prompt: string — text description for the preview (audio isn't visual)
